description: A clinic takes patient blood pressure either using an automatic machine or a manual machine. The automatic machine takes 10 minutes per patient while the manual machine takes 15 minutes per patient. Since the automatic machine frequently breaks, at least twice as many patients must have their blood pressure taken by the manual machine than the automatic machine. However, at least 20 patient can be processed by the automatic machine. If the clinic is open for 20000 minutes, maximize the number of patients whose blood pressure can be taken.

AutomaticMachineTimePerPatient.definition: Time taken by the automatic machine to process one patient.

ManualMachineTimePerPatient.definition: Time taken by the manual machine to process one patient.

ManualPatientMinRatio.definition: Minimum ratio of manual machine patients to automatic machine patients.

AutomaticMachineMinimumPatients.definition: Minimum number of patients that must be processed by the automatic machine.

TotalAvailableTime.definition: Total available time for the clinic in minutes.

objective.description: "Maximize the total number of patients whose blood pressure can be taken during the available clinic time."

constraints.description: 10 * (number of patients processed by automatic machine) + 15 * (number of patients processed by manual machine) <= TotalAvailableTime
(number of patients processed by manual machine) >= ManualPatientMinRatio * (number of patients processed by automatic machine)
(number of patients processed by automatic machine) >= AutomaticMachineMinimumPatients

AutomaticPatients.definition: Number of patients whose blood pressure is taken by the automatic machine

ManualPatients.definition: Number of patients whose blood pressure is taken by the manual machine
